flags.fix: Use another possessor in C-6 (e.g. 'My sister's man is a doctor' -> husband), and change the C-5 slip word to a kin word not keyed in form C (e.g. 'My dawghter...' style vowel slip on daughter).

flags.fix: Prefer a b-for-p slip on an A1 home word (e.g. not available in room names -> use a vowel slip such as 'kitchin'/'bedrom' under spelling_vowel), or keep one 'path room' item only.
